README.md.content:
# Private per-program decode object binding prototype

The embedded `decode_objects.json` section binds each complete decode program to one immutable, SHA256-identified object. The artifact emitter reuses the existing packet builder. Metadata absence preserves the original loader path; disabled emission copies the packet byte-for-byte. This is a private pilot, not merge-ready compiler integration.

Bindings: B1/B2 use the qualified old 200-register object (16,448-byte dynamic arena); B4/B8/B16 use the exact qualified S8 216-register object (82,944-byte arena). Both use 256 threads and 132 cooperative CTAs, with zero previously measured spills. No cubin or instruction math changes. The first GPU gate must validate actual cooperative capacity and resources again in this host.

The prototype is intentionally restricted to sm90a, 132 CUs, 256 threads, a strictly increasing complete plain cooperative decode ladder, and no decode segmentation/Lt/multistep/object override. PF segment graphs remain separate and supported. Per-context attention/NS/GF selection is unimplemented. This does not select an optimal kernel automatically.

The widest module is loaded once and reused; the old object is loaded once. Arc module owners retain the CUDA backend and unload once after graph/engine synchronization and all rung owners release them. Per-rung function, grid, block and arena are immutable load-time fields. Launch selection adds no allocation, module load, Arc clone, environment read or resource query. Tensor/KV/weight allocation, GQ/counter tables and physical-slot selection are unchanged. Sparse slot 15 selects rung 16.

Present malformed metadata rejects: incomplete/duplicate/unused mappings, duplicate numeric JSON IDs including aliases, invalid profile/ISA/entry/hash/path, mismatched exported resources/capabilities and unsupported cooperative capacity. SplitK ABI need is derived from the selected programs' opcodes, so the old object need not export the E3 marker. Optional metadata does not permit fallback after a validation failure.

CPU verification: four metadata tests and 261 CUDA runtime library tests pass (10 ignored). Initial failures are preserved in full-cpu-tests.initial.log: own environment accesses were changed to RuntimeConfig; missing private runtime header linkage was repaired by restoring the existing frozen PhaseB source symlink. No header/ABI edit was needed. Tests contain external frozen include_bytes fixtures and the pilot restrictions above; these must be replaced/generalized before any merge.

numerical-queue.json contains four native block captures plus two strict CPU qualifiers at 1K/32K. Each arm runs 20 steps: prefix rungs 1→2→4→8→16→8→4→2→1, sparse slot 15, then repeats after resetting all slots. LIVE=1 is mandatory. Checks retain all physical rows, exact upstream and untouched M1/M2 output, original S8 error limits, scratch/cast guards, untouched output tails and reset histories. These are native block gates, not full-model/logit or serving qualification. No GPU run has been performed by this agent. Timing remains held until numerical, occupancy and fresh-host memory qualification.

The new host changes anonymous sanitizer callsites and may add optional pairing probes when loading the second module. Do not reuse earlier E3/E6 API addresses or declare rc99 successful without fresh exact classification. Existing old packet/object evidence and failed staging/test logs remain preserved.

content.scope: Private artifact only; sm90a/132CU/256-thread cooperative decode. Batch binding only; no context policy. GPU numerical/memory/occupancy pending.
